notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API initially — started small pilot (2 months) and now moving to Dedicated sizing conversations. They have production roadmap to roll AI features into product search and in-app assistant H2 2026. Trial highlights: hosted trial showed good LM quality; cost volatility at peak hours was a concern. They requested a Dedicated capacity proposal with clear QPS/concurrency guarantees and unit economics.

Recent quotes/fragments: "We need a predictable per-minute SLA and capacity that won't spike billing unexpectedly" — VP Product. "Latency under 120ms p50 for chat flows is a hard req; we can tolerate p99 up to 500ms during peaks" — Eng manager.

Traffic profile + sizing ask: Provided numbers below from their hosted trial (Feb-Mar 2026). They want Redwood to propose Dedicated pool sizing and cost estimates.
- Observed avg QPS (in trial): 15 QPS sustained (US-east region) with diurnal spikes to 60 QPS for 30-45 minutes each weekday.
- Concurrency at peak: ~220 concurrent tokens streams (avg short chats 70 tokens user + 50 tokens model).
- Token mix: 65% short chat (50-150 tokens total), 25% long context generation (500-1200 tokens), 10% embeddings (avg 1024-d vectors) for search index updates.
- Expected growth: 3x over 6 months post-launch -> plan for 180 QPS headroom.
- Target SLOs: p50 latency <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms for chat endpoints.

POC & Demo notes:
- POC ran 2026-02-10 to 2026-03-02 using hosted_api. Demo on 2026-02-20 to execs; follow-up deep-dive with infra on 2026-02-25 (recorded FF-20260212-7120).
- They ran synthetic load tests (internal script) approximating target QPS; saw cache hit improvements when prefix caching enabled (~20% cost reduction).
- Engineering wants dedicated KV cache sizing guidance + recommended quantization profiles for 8-bit on A100-class nodes.

Requirements summary:
- Workloads: chat (primary), embeddings (secondary), reranking for search (occasional).
- Latency: strong emphasis on p50 p95 as above.
- Cost sensitivity: mid; willing to commit to reserved capacity with monthly commit if unit price reduces by ~30%.
- Routing/fallback: want auto-fallback to smaller/cheaper model during overload with graceful degradation (must preserve hallucination controls).
- Compliance: SOC2 required; data residency preference US-only for customer data.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver Dedicated sizing + cost estimate (Ravi) by 2026-03-08.
- Security pack + SOC2 attestation + KMS flow (SRE + Security) due 2026-03-12.
- Legal to review MSA and SLA; procurement kickoff 2026-03-20.
